chain_words.nuance: put forward an idea gently, without insisting
state a position and maintain it against objections
insist firmly on a view despite opposition
demand acceptance of a view forcefully and persistently

explanation: These words all express putting forward a view in discussion, from a tentative suggestion to forceful insistence.

usage_notes.difference: 'Assert' states a claim with confidence; 'insist' adds persistence and a demand that others accept it.
